title: Six-piece underwater ROV guard set
engineering: Projected open face is 77.74% on six assumed seats versus 55.57% for wider ribs. Outer fit margin is only 0.05 mm.
physical_check: Measure six exact seats and axial clearances. Test retention and thrust on the named host.

title: Manual deck tether reel
engineering: 58.07 m model capacity and 94 mm minimum drum diameter satisfy storage and bend checks. The 59 mm control fails the bend check.
physical_check: Wind a disconnected 50 m sample ten times and inspect bends and brake performance.

title: Enclosure vacuum check kit
engineering: Temperature compensation reduces synthetic blank gauge drift from 0.34 to 0.054 kPa. Synthetic leak control still exceeds 0.293 kPa after gauge allowances.
physical_check: Use a purchased rig and compatible blank. Compare three instrument levels and ten-minute drift.

title: Cable penetrator vise block
engineering: WetLink jaw schedule has 0.07–0.23 mm modeled clearance. Control can interfere by 0.05 mm.
physical_check: Fit all three sizes and assemble ten samples to supplier instructions. Inspect flats.

title: Clamp-on ROV instrument bridge
engineering: Four instrument slots and a static bar model on a surrogate. Revised deflection is 0.098 mm versus 1.856 mm.
physical_check: Fit customer's frame and check for permanent shift after a ten-minute proof fixture trial.

title: Paired clip-on trim floats
engineering: 30 g shim reduces modeled worst lift mismatch from 13.10% to 1.75%.
physical_check: Weigh both submerged lifts before and after 24 hours in intended pool conditions. Require within 5%.

title: Two-zone enclosure ingress alarm
engineering: All 40 simulated wettings latch the correct pad. The one-sample control latches early in 40 of 40 trials.
physical_check: Repeat ten freshwater and ten saline wettings on each physical pad and verify alarm reset.

title: Shallow tank drop camera
engineering: 300 mm flat-port model gives 16.42 pixels per 3 mm feature versus 5.47 at 640 columns.
physical_check: Read a target 30 cm away through the intended computer and lead before and after a two-hour soak.

title: Paired shallow inspection lights
engineering: Nine-point cone model estimates 659.9 lx or more. The high-thermal-resistance control exceeds the 52 °C screen.
physical_check: Measure lux and temperature and repeat electrical checks after the proposed shallow soak.

title: ROV tether fairlead
engineering: Nine-angle CSV gives 82.5 mm conservative bend diameter versus a 42.5 mm control and 75 mm cable limit.
physical_check: Test both rim widths and sweep a 5 m sample through working angles 100 times.
